messages:
Maya (PM): quick sync — ACME asked to bundle Dedicated + Priority lane into one contract line and want an exemption from surge softcaps for first 3 months. asking for risk/launch impact thoughts.

Jon (Eng): is this for a pilot or full reserved commit?

Elena (Sales): pilot -> they want predictable latency for launch. customer is pushing for contractual guarantee on burst credits during pilot.

Priya (Finance): exemptions to softcaps mean higher unit costs. need rough incremental $/token if we remove softcap for 90d.

Maya (PM): ballpark numbers ok. also need to understand operational complexity — can we gate this without special infra work?

Jon (Eng): technically we can route their traffic to a dedicated pool + priority lane flag. main work: add an entitlement check + per-contract override for burst policy. low-medium effort (2 sprints) if we reuse existing routing flags.

Sam (Legal): for contractual guarantee we need clear SLA metrics + carveouts. we can do a timeboxed exemption but must limit total excess tokens and define rollback triggers. sample clause: ```"Softcap Exemption: For the Initial Pilot Period (90 days), Customer shall receive temporary exemption from the Surge Softcap up to 2x of their committed throughput. Redwood reserves the right to throttle in case of infrastructure stress or security events. Any sustained usage beyond this allowance will be billed at Overage Rates and may trigger capacity discussions."```

Elena (Sales): can we make that 1.5x instead of 2x? customer prefers lower but still above softcap.

Priya (Finance): 1.5x easier to model. rough delta is +18% expected cost at 95th pct usage. need to flag to revenue ops for quoting.

Jon (Eng): operational checklist: (1) add per-contract flag in routing policy, (2) add per-contract burst allowance in billing metadata, (3) implement a heartbeat alert if usage > allowance for 3 consecutive 5m windows. I can prototype the routing flag this week.

Maya (PM): launch criteria proposal: - engineering prototype routing + billing metadata in staging, - legal clause reviewed and signed, - finance signoff on delta, - runway plan for fallback (auto-throttle + customer notif). all must be green to enable exemption.

Sam (Legal): also add an explicit rollback clause and opt-out timeline (7 days) so we can terminate exemption with notice.

Elena (Sales): customer ok with 7d notice. wants reporting telemetry: daily usage vs allowance. can BillingBot surface that? @BillingBot

BillingBot: Automated report setup: will add daily "pilot-usage" report for ACME starting tomorrow to their contract folder.

Priya (Finance): action items: I will run exact cost delta and add to quote worksheet by EOD Friday.

Jon (Eng): I’ll put a PR for the routing flag and alerting runbook by Thu.

Maya (PM): outcome: go/no-go call next Tue 10am. if all green we ship pilot exemption on Thu next week. thanks all. :thumbsup:

Elena (Sales): noted, looping in customer for expectation sync.

Sam (Legal): will circulate final clause edits tomorrow."
